title: Panmunjom: A Nuclear Alert Over One Poplar Tree
summary: Recounts how, on the eighteenth of August, nineteen seventy-six, in the Joint Security Area of the Korean Demilitarized Zone, North Korean soldiers attacked with axes a United Nations work party trying to trim the branches of a poplar tree that was blocking a line of sight, and killed two American officers within thirty seconds. The episode ranges from the DEFCON 3 alert to the eight-hundred-and-thirteen-man operation that cut the tree down in forty-two minutes under B-52s flown in from Guam, and to Kim Il-sung's message — the first since nineteen fifty-three to come anywhere near accepting responsibility.
